notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's certified candidate list and filed issues list. Issue wording is the Board's summary; the full wording is on the sample ballot.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice and issues list do not give local issue numbers; see your sample ballot for them.

issues.title: School district income tax: replace the 0.75% tax on school district income with a 2% tax on earned income, continuing, for current operating expenses
issues.area: Etna Township A/3, B, C, D; Harrison Township A–E (incl. Kirkersville); Pataskala 1-B/1, 3-A/1, 3-B/1, 3-B/3, 4-A/1, 4-B/1; St. Albans Township B-Alexandria/2; Union Township A/3, B/2; Reynoldsburg 3-B/2
issues.text: Shall the existing tax of 0.75% on the school district income of individuals imposed by the Southwest Licking Local School District be replaced by a tax of 2% on the earned income of individuals residing in the school district for a continuing period of time, beginning January 1, 2027, for the purpose of paying the cost of current operating expenses? If the new tax is not approved, the existing tax will remain in effect under its original authority, for the remainder of its previously approved term.
